scenarios.name: stationary_doppler

scenarios.name: stationary_position_only

scenarios.description: 30 s fix gap mid-run, no pedometer: gap not credited

scenarios.name: gap_with_steps
scenarios.description: stride learned over 80 s, then 40 s fix gap filled by steps x stride

scenarios.name: short_gap_with_steps
scenarios.description: 6 s fix gap: filter integrates it, buffered steps discarded

scenarios.name: trailing_gap_with_steps

scenarios.name: invalid_inputs
scenarios.description: non-monotonic t (ignored), speed>max and speedAcc>1.5 (Doppler ignored, fix kept), negative accuracy (floored), bad step count
